_comment: Mutation testing over the emulator-free unit suite (see vitest.mutation.config.ts for why the integration suite is excluded). Two numbers matter here and they are far apart: the score over COVERED code is 82.6%, while the TOTAL is 31.6% because ~1,560 mutants sit in code only the Firestore emulator can reach (sync.ts, provider.ts, compaction.ts, squash.ts). break=30 is a ratchet on the total: raise it as pure logic is extracted into policy modules, never lower it.
